name: cfg-router-stats
about: router.stats（parseRouterConfig.ts:646-735；router/stats/*：落盘 ~/.pilotdeck/router/stats.jsonl）：modelPricing 给 bbx/priced 定价（input / output / cacheRead / unit=¥/百万 Token），baselineModel 用对象写法指向 bbx/baseline（另给它定价，用来算 savedCost），retentionMs 很大；一轮在 bbx/priced 上的对话后比 stats.jsonl、usage_snapshot / model_usage_snapshot 与 resolve_settings。filePath 不从 YAML 读（schema.ts:66），这里写一个 {ROOT} 下的路径，看它是否被忽略。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/priced
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      retry:
        streamMaxRetries: 0
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        broken:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb1:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb2:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        zero:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        priced:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        baseline:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
router:
  enabled: true
  stats:
    enabled: true
    retentionMs: 86400000000
    filePath: {ROOT}/should-not-exist/stats.jsonl
    baselineModel:
      provider: bbx
      model: baseline
    modelPricing:
      bbx/priced:
        input: 3
        output: 15
        cacheRead: 0.3
        unit: ¥/百万 Token
      bbx/baseline:
        input: 30
        output: 150
